name: Packer Maureen

intro.text: Forty years I've packed biscuits at Carr's. Do you know how many I've eaten? None. You can't. Not any more. It's the smell.

win: That was a flawless round. I'll have a biscuit to celebrate. A single one.
after: I'm retiring in the spring. They'll miss me. Or at least the biscuits will.
